description: Summary, key points, and timestamped study notes for a public YouTube video, generated from its transcript. Written in the transcript's language (translate_to changes which transcript is summarized). Costs 1 credit for the transcript plus 1 for the summary (2 total) for most videos; long videos cost about 1 more per further 45 minutes.

language.description: Preferred caption language (BCP-47, e.g. en, es, pt-BR)

translate_to.description: Summarize a translation of the transcript into this language

name: summarize_video
title: Summarize a YouTube video
